description: Licence: prepare (unsigned) the Air licence for ZENI (approve first). There are only TWO tiers: 1 Ground (not for sale, nothing needs it) and 2 Air (the one on sale, tier 2). The licence is a stamp on your wallet; today the only thing that reads it is the insurance for helicopters and jets, and insurance is switched off. It does NOT let you race (aircraft can never race) and the vehicle heist, convoy, Ledger and raids do not check it. Renewable near expiry. Disk holders pay less.

tier.description: 2 for the Air licence (1 Ground is not for sale; the contract refuses anything above 2).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.
